subject: Coordinating a rolling three-hour window (US/EU/APAC) for NorthStar integration demo
messages:
From: jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com
To: tom.baxter@northstar-sys.com
Cc: markus.klein@redwood-inference.com, ava.chen@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 08:02:00 -0500
Subject: Coordinating a rolling three-hour window (US/EU/APAC) for NorthStar integration demo

Tom — good to meet you last week. Per our call, NorthStar wants an integration demo that includes AE-led overview, SE deep-dive on the VPC/networking model, and a short procurement/security checklist at the end. Because your team spans US, EU and APAC, we'd like to propose a rotating three-hour window so we capture morning/evening overlaps without requiring anyone to be on extremely late calls every week.

Quick ask: can you share who needs to be on the recurring session (names/titles + timezones) and any absolute blackout windows (e.g., no calls after 6pm CET)? Below are 3 initial candidate windows (localized):

- Option A: 08:00–11:00 PST / 16:00–19:00 CET (good for US mornings + EU late afternoons)
- Option B: 12:00–15:00 PST / 20:00–23:00 CET / 05:00–08:00 JST (rotates to favor APAC early)
- Option C: 22:00–01:00 PST (next day) / 06:00–09:00 CET / 13:00–16:00 JST (APAC-friendly mid-day)

Markus (SE) — I copied you for network and GPU capacity comments. Ava (security) — can you flag any immediate must-haves for the kickoff session (SOC2 artifact, IP allowlist, etc.)?

Attached: draft mutual action plan (MAP) showing required stakeholders + 30/60/90 milestones. If we can get availability today or tomorrow, I’ll propose a rotating cadence and send a calendar series.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform

Attachments: NorthStar_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf (12KB stub)

From: tom.baxter@northstar-sys.com
To: jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com
Cc: priya.reddy@northstar-sys.com
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 13:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Coordinating a rolling three-hour window (US/EU/APAC) for NorthStar integration demo

Jasmine — thanks, this looks good. Quick notes from my side:

- Attendees: me (Tom Baxter, Lead Platform Eng, GMT), Priya Reddy (Integrations PM, IST), and our procurement alias (procurement@northstar-sys.com). We may pull in a security engineer for the first call — likely Arun Shah (arun.shah@northstar-sys.com).
- Hard constraints: no meetings after 17:30 CET (we have biweekly board prep), and our APAC folks prefer not to be on calls before 08:30 IST.

Option A is the cleanest for the EU/US overlap but leaves APAC joining late (Priya can join at the tail end). Option B would force APAC to join very early.

Can Markus propose a lean agenda per 3-hour window (what gets covered in first 60/90/180 mins) so we can route to our stakeholders? Also procurement asked to see an estimate of required onboarding resources (SOW ballpark) before we lock a recurring invite.

—Tom

On attachments: I’ll ask procurement to share PO terms, but please include a stub of network prerequisites if possible so our infra team can pre-check.

From: markus.klein@redwood-inference.com
To: tom.baxter@northstar-sys.com, jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com
Cc: ava.chen@redwood-inference.com, evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 14:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Coordinating a rolling three-hour window (US/EU/APAC) for NorthStar integration demo

Thanks Tom — here’s a recommended lean agenda mapped to a 3‑hour window (we can compress for 90–120m if needed):

- 00:00–00:20 (AE): Product overview and business fit (Jasmine)
- 00:20–01:00 (SE): Architecture walkthrough — deployment modes (hosted, dedicated, private) and traffic patterns
- 01:00–01:30 (SE): Deep-dive: network/firewall requirements + KV caching behavior for warm starts
- 01:30–02:15 (SE): Live demo: model deployment, latency profiling, and fallback policy demo
- 02:15–02:45 (SEC/PROC): Security & procurement checklist, PO next steps (Ava + Procurement)
- 02:45–03:00 (AE): Recap, action items, next steps

Network skim: for a full end-to-end demo we ask for a single NATed egress CIDR and allowlist rules for inbound only if you request private deployment. Typical bandwidth observed during heavy demo load is ~80–150 Mbps sustained for multi-request scenarios — I’m attaching a quick CSV with port/IP stubs.

Proposed cadence: rotate which region is favored each week so no one team is always out-of-hours. Example rotation: Week 1 — US-friendly slot (Option A), Week 2 — EU-friendly slot (a midday CET slot), Week 3 — APAC-friendly slot (Option C variant).

Attachments: network_requirements.csv (2KB stub).

—Markus Klein
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood-inference.com

> On Mon, 22 Nov 2026 at 08:02, jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com wrote:
> > Tom — good to meet you last week. Per our call, NorthStar wants an integration demo...

From: procurement@northstar-sys.com
To: jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com, tom.baxter@northstar-sys.com
Cc: priya.reddy@northstar-sys.com
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2026 09:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Coordinating a rolling three-hour window (US/EU/APAC) for NorthStar integration demo

Hi Jasmine — procurement here. We’ll need a short SOW-level estimate and a typical payment timeline before we can commit to a recurring series. Can you share:

1) Ballpark onboarding cost range (one-time) and typical monthly committed spend ranges for a 3-node dedicated setup vs hosted usage.
2) Cancellation/termination lead times (standard contract language).

If you have a simple one-page SOW or a pricing snapshot you can attach, please do. We can schedule the demo while commercial details are reviewed, but we need that info within 48 hours to prioritize.

Thanks,
NorthStar Procurement

From: ava.chen@redwood-inference.com
To: procurement@northstar-sys.com, jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com
Cc: markus.klein@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coordinating a rolling three-hour window (US/EU/APAC) for NorthStar integration demo

Hi all — quick security note: for the kickoff we can provide a SOC2 snapshot and our standard onboarding checklist. Two immediate asks from our side:

- Provide a list of IP ranges that will originate demo traffic (so we can set a temporary allowlist).
- Confirm whether any demo data will include customer PII or if you’ll use synthetic data (we prefer synthetic for early demos).

I attached a short SOC2 snapshot for your security team to review. If NorthStar requires an HSM/KMS integration for secrets in private deployment, that will add ~2–3 weeks to the onboarding timeline.

—Ava Chen
Manager, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood-inference.com

Attachments: SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf (45KB stub)

From: jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com
To: tom.baxter@northstar-sys.com, priya.reddy@northstar-sys.com, procurement@northstar-sys.com
Cc: markus.klein@redwood-inference.com, ava.chen@redwood-inference.com, evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2026 23:12:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Coordinating a rolling three-hour window (US/EU/APAC) for NorthStar integration demo

Thanks everyone — great inputs. Based on constraints and the rotation idea, here’s what I’ll put on the calendar as a repeating 3-week rotation (first three occurrences below). Please confirm or flag conflicts within 24 hours and we’ll adjust.

Week 1 (US-favored): Tue 30 Nov 2026, 08:00–11:00 PST / Tue 30 Nov 2026, 16:00–19:00 CET / Wed 01 Dec 2026, 00:00–03:00 JST — Focus: business fit + SE deep dive (short security Q&A)
Week 2 (EU-favored): Tue 7 Dec 2026, 14:00–17:00 CET / Tue 7 Dec 2026, 05:00–08:00 PST / Tue 7 Dec 2026, 22:00–01:00 JST — Focus: architecture walkthrough + procurement questions
Week 3 (APAC-favored): Tue 14 Dec 2026, 13:00–16:00 JST / Tue 14 Dec 2026, 03:00–06:00 CET / Mon 13 Dec 2026, 18:00–21:00 PST — Focus: live integration, runbook, and PO checklist

I’m attaching the calendar series (Google event link) and the MAP. Procurement — I’ll follow up with a one-page SOW and ballpark ranges by EOD tomorrow to meet your 48-hour ask. Markus — please confirm the bandwidth numbers in the CSV are acceptable for demo load. Ava — noted on HSM impact; will surface to NorthStar if they indicate private deployment interest.

If everyone confirms, I’ll send the recurring invite and include action items: attendee list, sample synthetic dataset, and pre-demo checklist.

Best,
Jasmine

Attachments: NorthStar_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf, calendar_invite_link.txt (event stub)
